description_en: Queries jobs under a specified node
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定任务下的作业
name: QueryTask

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the job under the node
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The job details returned if the invocation was successful. See the following parameter descriptions for details
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的作业详情，请参见以下参数说明

IotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This ID is the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，作为该设备的唯一标识符

JobId.description_en: The ID of the node to which the job belongs

JobName.description_en: The name of the node to which the job belongs

Message.description_en: The information about the node execution, such as error messages
Message.description_zh: 任务执行的相关信息，例如执行的错误信息
Message.example: this is message about task execution

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

Status.description_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

QUEUED: Pending scheduling.
SENT: Scheduled.
IN_PROGRESS: Running.
FAILED: Failed.
REJECTED: Rejected.
TIMED_OUT: Timed out.
SUCCEEDED: Succeeded.
CANCELLED: Canceled
Status.description_zh:
作业的状态。

QUEUED：待调度。
SENT：已调度。
IN_PROGRESS：执行中。
FAILED：失败。
REJECTED：已拒绝。
TIMED_OUT：已超时。
SUCCEEDED：已成功。
CANCELLED：已取消

StatusDetail.description_en: The information reported by the device during job execution
StatusDetail.description_zh: 任务作业执行过程中设备上报的信息

TaskId.description_en: The job ID. The globally unique identifier of the job
TaskId.description_zh: 作业ID。作业的全局唯一标识符

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the job information was last modified

UtcQueueTime.description_en: The time when the job was queued

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
